newsitem.title: CANADA: TELUS Corp to exit UK cable/telcom industry.
newsitem.headline: TELUS Corp to exit UK cable/telcom industry.

text.p: Canadian telephone company TELUS Corp said it planned to sell its 50-percent interest in Telecential Communications to partner Vision Networks NV for C$390 million, ending a four-year foray into the British cable television and telecommunications industries.
TELUS said it would post a C$128 million gain from the sale, which was expected to be closed within 60 days.
The total price would also include reimbursement of any further advnaces TELUS made to the venture, it said.
Dutch firm Vision, formerly KPN Kabel BV, entered the venture in late 1995 after buying Canadian cable firm Shaw Communications Inc's share.
TELUS said the investment was a good one, giving it experience in competing in both entertainment and telephone service.
However, the sale would allow it to concentrate on Canadian operations, the company said.
TELUS entered the joint venture in 1993.
